verses.he: לַמְנַצֵּ֥חַ עַֽל־*יְדִיתוּן (יְדוּת֗וּן) לְאָסָ֥ף מִזְמֹֽור׃
verses.ar: لِإِمَامِ ٱلْمُغَنِّينَ عَلَى «يَدُوثُونَ». لِآسَافَ. مَزْمُورٌ
verses.en: For the Leader; for Jeduthun. A Psalm of Asaph.
verses.kjv: To the chief Musician, to Jeduthun, A Psalm of Asaph.
verses.web: For the Chief Musician. To Jeduthun. A Psalm by Asaph.

verses.he: קֹולִ֣י אֶל־אֱלֹהִ֣ים וְאֶצְעָ֑קָה קֹולִ֥י אֶל־אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים וְהַאֲזִ֥ין אֵלָֽי׃
verses.ar: صَوْتِي إِلَى ٱللهِ فَأَصْرُخُ. صَوْتِي إِلَى ٱللهِ فَأَصْغَى إِلَيَّ.
verses.en: I will lift up my voice unto God, and cry; I will lift up my voice unto God, that He may give ear unto me.
verses.kjv: I cried unto God with my voice, [even] unto God with my voice; and he gave ear unto me.
verses.web: My cry goes to God! Indeed, I cry to God for help, and for him to listen to me.

verses.he: בְּיֹ֥ום צָרָתִי֮ אֲדֹנָ֪י דָּ֫רָ֥שְׁתִּי יָדִ֤י ׀ לַ֣יְלָה נִ֭גְּרָה וְלֹ֣א תָפ֑וּג מֵאֲנָ֖ה הִנָּחֵ֣ם נַפְשִֽׁי׃
verses.ar: فِي يَوْمِ ضِيْقِي ٱلْتَمَسْتُ ٱلرَّبَّ. يَدِي فِي ٱللَّيْلِ ٱنْبَسَطَتْ وَلَمْ تَخْدَرْ. أَبَتْ نَفْسِي ٱلتَّعْزِيَةَ.
verses.en: In the day of my trouble I seek the Lord; with my hand uplifted, mine eye streameth in the night without ceasing; my soul refuseth to be comforted.
verses.kjv: In the day of my trouble I sought the Lord: my sore ran in the night, and ceased not: my soul refused to be comforted.
verses.web: In the day of my trouble I sought the Lord. My hand was stretched out in the night, and didn’t get tired. My soul refused to be comforted.

verses.he: אֶזְכְּרָ֣ה אֱלֹהִ֣ים וְאֶֽהֱמָיָ֑ה אָשִׂ֓יחָה ׀ וְתִתְעַטֵּ֖ף רוּחִ֣י סֶֽלָה׃
verses.ar: أَذْكُرُ ٱللهَ فَأَئِنُّ. أُنَاجِي نَفْسِي فَيُغْشَى عَلَى رُوحِي. سِلَاهْ.
verses.en: When I think thereon, O God, I must moan; when I muse thereon, my spirit fainteth. Selah
verses.kjv: I remembered God, and was troubled: I complained, and my spirit was overwhelmed. Selah.
verses.web: I remember God, and I groan. I complain, and my spirit is overwhelmed. Selah.

verses.he: אָ֭חַזְתָּ שְׁמֻרֹ֣ות עֵינָ֑י נִ֝פְעַ֗מְתִּי וְלֹ֣א אֲדַבֵּֽר׃
verses.ar: أَمْسَكْتَ أَجْفَانَ عَيْنَيَّ. ٱنْزَعَجْتُ فَلَمْ أَتَكَلَّمْ.
verses.en: Thou holdest fast the lids of mine eyes; I am troubled, and cannot speak.
verses.kjv: Thou holdest mine eyes waking: I am so troubled that I cannot speak.
verses.web: You hold my eyelids open. I am so troubled that I can’t speak.

verses.he: חִשַּׁ֣בְתִּי יָמִ֣ים מִקֶּ֑דֶם שְׁ֝נֹ֗ות עֹולָמִֽים׃
verses.ar: تَفَكَّرْتُ فِي أَيَّامِ ٱلْقِدَمِ، ٱلسِّنِينَ ٱلدَّهْرِيَّةِ.
verses.en: I have pondered the days of old, the years of ancient times.
verses.kjv: I have considered the days of old, the years of ancient times.
verses.web: I have considered the days of old, the years of ancient times.

verses.he: אֶֽזְכְּרָ֥ה נְגִינָתִ֗י בַּ֫לָּ֥יְלָה עִם־לְבָבִ֥י אָשִׂ֑יחָה וַיְחַפֵּ֥שׂ רוּחִֽי׃
verses.ar: أَذْكُرُ تَرَنُّمِي فِي ٱللَّيْلِ. مَعَ قَلْبِي أُنَاجِي، وَرُوحِي تَبْحَثُ:
verses.en: In the night I will call to remembrance my song; I will commune with mine own heart; and my spirit maketh diligent search:
verses.kjv: I call to remembrance my song in the night: I commune with mine own heart: and my spirit made diligent search.
verses.web: I remember my song in the night. I consider in my own heart; my spirit diligently inquires:

verses.he: הַֽ֭לְעֹולָמִים יִזְנַ֥ח ׀ אֲדֹנָ֑י וְלֹֽא־יֹסִ֖יף לִרְצֹ֣ות עֹֽוד׃
verses.ar: «هَلْ إِلَى ٱلدُّهُورِ يَرْفُضُ ٱلرَّبُّ، وَلَا يَعُودُ لِلرِّضَا بَعْدُ؟
verses.en: 'Will the Lord cast off for ever? and will He be favourable no more?
verses.kjv: Will the Lord cast off for ever? and will he be favourable no more?
verses.web: “Will the Lord reject us forever? Will he be favorable no more?

verses.he: הֶאָפֵ֣ס לָנֶ֣צַח חַסְדֹּ֑ו גָּ֥מַר אֹ֝֗מֶר לְדֹ֣ר וָדֹֽר׃
verses.ar: هَلِ ٱنْتَهَتْ إِلَى ٱلْأَبَدِ رَحْمَتُهُ؟ ٱنْقَطَعَتْ كَلِمَتُهُ إِلَى دَوْرٍ فَدَوْرٍ؟
verses.en: Is His mercy clean gone for ever? Is His promise come to an end for evermore?
verses.kjv: Is his mercy clean gone for ever? doth [his] promise fail for evermore?
verses.web: Has his loving kindness vanished forever? Does his promise fail for generations?

verses.he: הֲשָׁכַ֣ח חַנֹּ֣ות אֵ֑ל אִם־קָפַ֥ץ בְּ֝אַ֗ף רַחֲמָ֥יו סֶֽלָה׃
verses.ar: هَلْ نَسِيَ ٱللهُ رَأْفَةً؟ أَوْ قَفَصَ بِرِجْزِهِ مَرَاحِمَهُ؟». سِلَاهْ.
verses.en: Hath God forgotten to be gracious? Hath He in anger shut up his compassions?' Selah
verses.kjv: Hath God forgotten to be gracious? hath he in anger shut up his tender mercies? Selah.
verses.web: Has God forgotten to be gracious? Has he, in anger, withheld his compassion?” Selah.

verses.he: וָ֭אֹמַר חַלֹּ֣ותִי הִ֑יא שְׁ֝נֹ֗ות יְמִ֣ין עֶלְיֹֽון׃
verses.ar: فَقُلْتُ: «هَذَا مَا يُعِلُّنِي: تَغَيُّرُ يَمِينِ ٱلْعَلِيِّ».
verses.en: And I say: 'This is my weakness, that the right hand of the Most High could change.
verses.kjv: And I said, This [is] my infirmity: [but I will remember] the years of the right hand of the most High.
verses.web: Then I thought, “I will appeal to this: the years of the right hand of the Most High.”

verses.he: *אַזְכִּיר (אֶזְכֹּ֥ור) מַֽעַלְלֵי־יָ֑הּ כִּֽי־אֶזְכְּרָ֖ה מִקֶּ֣דֶם פִּלְאֶֽךָ׃
verses.ar: أَذْكُرُ أَعْمَالَ ٱلرَّبِّ. إِذْ أَتَذَكَّرُ عَجَائِبَكَ مُنْذُ ٱلْقِدَمِ،
verses.en: I will make mention of the deeds of the LORD; yea, I will remember Thy wonders of old.
verses.kjv: I will remember the works of the LORD: surely I will remember thy wonders of old.
verses.web: I will remember Yah’s deeds; for I will remember your wonders of old.

verses.he: וְהָגִ֥יתִי בְכָל־פָּעֳלֶ֑ךָ וּֽבַעֲלִ֖ילֹותֶ֣יךָ אָשִֽׂיחָה׃
verses.ar: وَأَلْهَجُ بِجَمِيعِ أَفْعَالِكَ، وَبِصَنَائِعِكَ أُنَاجِي.
verses.en: I will meditate also upon all Thy work, and muse on Thy doings.'
verses.kjv: I will meditate also of all thy work, and talk of thy doings.
verses.web: I will also meditate on all your work, and consider your doings.

verses.he: אֱ֭לֹהִים בַּקֹּ֣דֶשׁ דַּרְכֶּ֑ךָ מִי־אֵ֥ל גָּ֝דֹ֗ול כֵּֽאלֹהִֽים׃
verses.ar: اَللَّهُمَّ، فِي ٱلْقُدْسِ طَرِيقُكَ. أَيُّ إِلَهٍ عَظِيمٌ مِثْلُ ٱللهِ؟
verses.en: O God, Thy way is in holiness; who is a great god like unto God?
verses.kjv: Thy way, O God, [is] in the sanctuary: who [is so] great a God as [our] God?
verses.web: Your way, God, is in the sanctuary. What god is great like God?

verses.he: אַתָּ֣ה הָ֭אֵל עֹ֣שֵׂה פֶ֑לֶא הֹודַ֖עְתָּ בָעַמִּ֣ים עֻזֶּֽךָ׃
verses.ar: أَنْتَ ٱلْإِلَهُ ٱلصَّانِعُ ٱلْعَجَائِبَ. عَرَّفْتَ بَيْنَ ٱلشُّعُوبِ قُوَّتَكَ.
verses.en: Thou art the God that doest wonders; Thou hast made known Thy strength among the peoples.
verses.kjv: Thou [art] the God that doest wonders: thou hast declared thy strength among the people.
verses.web: You are the God who does wonders. You have made your strength known among the peoples.

verses.he: גָּאַ֣לְתָּ בִּזְרֹ֣ועַ עַמֶּ֑ךָ בְּנֵי־יַעֲקֹ֖ב וְיֹוסֵ֣ף סֶֽלָה׃
verses.ar: فَكَكْتَ بِذِرَاعِكَ شَعْبَكَ، بَنِي يَعْقُوبَ وَيُوسُفَ. سِلَاهْ.
verses.en: Thou hast with Thine arm redeemed Thy people, the sons of Jacob and Joseph. Selah
verses.kjv: Thou hast with [thine] arm redeemed thy people, the sons of Jacob and Joseph. Selah.
verses.web: You have redeemed your people with your arm, the sons of Jacob and Joseph. Selah.

verses.he: רָ֘א֤וּךָ מַּ֨יִם ׀ אֱ‍ֽלֹהִ֗ים רָא֣וּךָ מַּ֣יִם יָחִ֑ילוּ אַ֝֗ף יִרְגְּז֥וּ תְהֹמֹֽות׃
verses.ar: أَبْصَرَتْكَ ٱلْمِيَاهُ يَا ٱللهُ، أَبْصَرَتْكَ ٱلْمِيَاهُ فَفَزِعَتْ، اِرْتَعَدَتْ أَيْضًا ٱللُّجَجُ.
verses.en: The waters saw Thee, O God; the waters saw Thee, they were in pain; the depths also trembled.
verses.kjv: The waters saw thee, O God, the waters saw thee; they were afraid: the depths also were troubled.
verses.web: The waters saw you, God. The waters saw you, and they writhed. The depths also convulsed.

verses.he: זֹ֤רְמוּ מַ֨יִם ׀ עָבֹ֗ות קֹ֖ול נָתְנ֣וּ שְׁחָקִ֑ים אַף־חֲ֝צָצֶ֗יךָ יִתְהַלָּֽכוּ׃
verses.ar: سَكَبَتِ ٱلْغُيُومُ مِيَاهًا، أَعْطَتِ ٱلسُّحُبُ صَوْتًا. أَيْضًا سِهَامُكَ طَارَتْ.
verses.en: The clouds flooded forth waters; the skies sent out a sound; Thine arrows also went abroad.
verses.kjv: The clouds poured out water: the skies sent out a sound: thine arrows also went abroad.
verses.web: The clouds poured out water. The skies resounded with thunder. Your arrows also flashed around.

verses.he: קֹ֤ול רַעַמְךָ֨ ׀ בַּגַּלְגַּ֗ל הֵאִ֣ירוּ בְרָקִ֣ים תֵּבֵ֑ל רָגְזָ֖ה וַתִּרְעַ֣שׁ הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.ar: صَوْتُ رَعْدِكَ فِي ٱلزَّوْبَعَةِ. ٱلْبُرُوقُ أَضَاءَتِ ٱلْمَسْكُونَةَ. ٱرْتَعَدَتْ وَرَجَفَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ.
verses.en: The voice of Thy thunder was in the whirlwind; the lightnings lighted up the world; the earth trembled and shook.
verses.kjv: The voice of thy thunder [was] in the heaven: the lightnings lightened the world: the earth trembled and shook.
verses.web: The voice of your thunder was in the whirlwind. The lightnings lit up the world. The earth trembled and shook.

verses.he: בַּיָּ֤ם דַּרְכֶּ֗ךָ *וּשְׁבִילֶיךָ (וּֽ֭שְׁבִֽילְךָ) בְּמַ֣יִם רַבִּ֑ים וְ֝עִקְּבֹותֶ֗יךָ לֹ֣א נֹדָֽעוּ׃
verses.ar: فِي ٱلْبَحْرِ طَرِيقُكَ، وَسُبُلُكَ فِي ٱلْمِيَاهِ ٱلْكَثِيرَةِ، وَآثَارُكَ لَمْ تُعْرَفْ.
verses.en: Thy way was in the sea, and Thy path in the great waters, and Thy footsteps were not known.
verses.kjv: Thy way [is] in the sea, and thy path in the great waters, and thy footsteps are not known.
verses.web: Your way was through the sea, your paths through the great waters. Your footsteps were not known.

verses.he: נָחִ֣יתָ כַצֹּ֣אן עַמֶּ֑ךָ בְּֽיַד־מֹשֶׁ֥ה וְאַהֲרֹֽן׃
verses.ar: هَدَيْتَ شَعْبَكَ كَٱلْغَنَمِ بِيَدِ مُوسَى وَهارُونَ.
verses.en: Thou didst lead Thy people like a flock, by the hand of Moses and Aaron.
verses.kjv: Thou leddest thy people like a flock by the hand of Moses and Aaron.
verses.web: You led your people like a flock, by the hand of Moses and Aaron.
